shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---DOCS---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
cat /workspace/package.json && echo "---" && cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "view.transition\|viewTransition" . | head -40
cd /workspace && find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -60 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts
for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" lib/products.ts; do echo "=========== $f"; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && sed -n '/transitionTypes/,/^## /p' 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80
grep -n "transitionTypes" -A 40 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | sed -n '/### .transitionTypes/,/### /p' | head -60
cd /workspace && cat app/globals.css && echo "======EVAL" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rn -i "viewTransition" 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md 01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md | head -20; echo "---config?---"; grep -rn "experimental.*viewTransition\|viewTransition: true" -r . | head

cd /workspace && node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('react', r.version, 'ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition)" ; echo "--- types ---"; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "ViewTransition\b" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/plugins/next-types-plugin/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3

ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/ | grep -i "^react" | head -20; echo "--- check exports ---"; for d in react react-experimental; do f=node_modules/next/dist/compiled/$d/cjs/react.production.js; if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "$d: $(grep -c 'ViewTransition' $f)"; fi; done

grep -o "ViewTransition[^,;)]*" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | head -5; echo "=== version ==="; grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json').version)"

node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version)"; echo "--- grep all @types/react files ---"; grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/ | head; echo "--- next types ---"; grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat tsconfig.json
cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls .next/types 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== canary.d.ts ViewTransition ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" -B 30 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | sed -n '1,80p'
grep -n "share?" -A 6 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== link.d.ts ==="; grep -n "transitionTypes" -B 6 node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -35

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- HOME grid image tags ---"; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o '<div class="product-image"[^>]*>' | head -4; echo "--- link transitionTypes leaked as attr? ---"; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'transitionTypes' | head -2; echo "--- DETAIL hero ---"; curl -s localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div class="product-hero"[^>]*>' | head -2
curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o '.\{60\}transitionTypes.\{40\}' | head -3; echo "=== anchor tags ==="; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o '<a [^>]*product/classic[^>]*>' | head -2

curl -s localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers > /tmp/d.html; grep -o '<a [^>]*class="back-link"[^>]*>' /tmp/d.html | head -2; echo "--- skeleton present (streamed) ---"; grep -c "skeleton-text large" /tmp/d.html; echo "=== SERVER LOG (warnings/errors) ==="; grep -i "warn\|error\|invalid" /tmp/next.log | head -10; echo "(end)"; pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server"; echo killed
(curl -s -m 2 localhost:3123 >/dev/null && echo "SERVER STILL UP" || echo "server down"); echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json
cat next-env.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10; echo "typecheck exit: $?"
